hypothesis: R402 learned policies fail registered physical gate
basis: All 36 learning arm-seed-profile blocks fail common no-harm and action-stress families; both endpoint medians are worse than deterministic.
The no-message arm is not a clean ablation because actor/target training sees full message slots while execution masks them.

hypothesis: No-message train–execution mask mismatch contributed to its failure
basis: Code defect is mechanical and final weights load message slots, but no corrected paired ANDES intervention exists.

hypothesis: Stateful slew/hidden-action mismatch contributed to all learned-arm failures
basis: Code mismatch is mechanical and slew is frequently active; corrected paired experiment absent.

hypothesis: Missing componentwise action-effort regularization caused action stress
basis: CD objective omits effort and observed actions/TV/clamps are large; R404 combines effort with another repair and cannot isolate the effect.

hypothesis: Missing effort alone caused endpoint degradation
basis: Action stress can alter dynamics, but endpoint causality is not isolated and objective/optimization/interface alternatives remain.

hypothesis: Scalar TD3 disproves the effort hypothesis
basis: Its action terms penalize squared global means, not componentwise RMS/TV; differential cancellation can evade them.

hypothesis: Multiplier deleted the common objective throughout training
basis: Only final-20 and six coarse checkpoints exist; lambda is often zero/small in the tail but not continuously observed and gradient scales are missing.

hypothesis: Multiplier calibration weakened common pressure in the retained tail
basis: Across the 19 exactly recoverable final-tail episode usages per CD run, zero-lambda fractions are 0.368–0.895 and <0.1 fractions are 0.737–1.000.
Training per-trajectory squared costs differ from signed odd-response endpoints and reference-relative guards; P_es term is unavailable in evaluation logs.
No losses, Bellman calibration, replay coverage or checkpoint performance; substantial late parameter drift is diagnostic, not a certificate.

hypothesis: Direct M/D has no physical authority
basis: The deterministic direct-M/D controller materially improves endpoints and passes guards.

hypothesis: Direct M/D has limited learnable incremental headroom
basis: Strong comparator and interface geometry support plausibility; R402-specific DAE authority matrices/interventions are absent.

hypothesis: Energy-port success proves action-basis mismatch caused R402
basis: Energy-port evidence is a different actuator/estimator/bank object and was not a matched intervention.

verdict: False if saturation means lower-clamp inactivity
basis: Normalized boundary saturation is zero, but 179/216 learning trajectories contain at least one physical M/D lower-clamp event.
Comparator and learner paths differ, but learner train/eval scale is internally matched; a uniform-adapter reproduction is needed.

hypothesis: Memoryless observation/state insufficiency materially contributed to failure
basis: The actor omits previous action, current/baseline M-D, profile identity and explicit phase. F2 proves one hidden action-state mismatch, but the deterministic reference rules out a blanket impossibility claim.

hypothesis: Centralized-critic credit assignment caused the failure
basis: Four independent actors use a shared global critic and coordinate-wise actor updates, but no per-agent counterfactual values, gradient decomposition or calibrated alternative is retained.

hypothesis: Development-to-evaluation distribution shift caused the failure
basis: Training and evaluation profiles differ, while no final or periodic learned-checkpoint evaluation on the development profiles was retained.
